content: Darent Valley Hospital is a 460-bed acute general hospital located in Dartford, Kent, England. The hospital features an Accident and Emergency (A&E) department, which is complemented by a walk-in service for patients requiring immediate care. It is managed by the Dartford & Gravesham NHS Trust. This hospital holds the distinction of being the first in the UK to be procured under a Private Finance Initiative (PFI) contract. The architectural design of the hospital was undertaken by Nightingale Paull & Associates, and the construction was carried out by Carillion. The facility officially opened its doors to the public in July 2000. On January 2, 2007, a new on-site Heart Centre was inaugurated, further expanding the hospital's range of specialized services. Darent Valley Hospital employs approximately 1,900 staff members, ensuring the delivery of high-quality healthcare services to the community.
